title: spec tooling(check:variant-docs): the walker reads only literal discriminator arms, never a zod 4 z.enum arm, so a discriminatedUnion arm keyed by z.enum([...]) is ledgered under a key that does not move when its enum members change
body:
domain:spec#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmSduNGC2SZXszyrNut

Filing gate: ① an out-of-scope finding named by the `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review of PR #29401 (#27928). ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets it.

## What the gate does (read on PR #29401's head, not run)

`packages/spec/scripts/check-variant-docs.mts` builds each discriminated-union arm's key from the discriminator's literal values (`dd.values`). A zod 4 `z.enum([...])` discriminator carries its members in `entries` instead, and the walker does not read that field. On PR #29401, `GetPackageCustomizationsResponseSchema.contributions` is `z.discriminatedUnion('kind', [ <kind: z.enum(['field','flow'])> , <kind: z.literal('nav')> ])`, so its `variant-docs.json` entry is keyed `kind:nav` alone. If the enum arm gained or lost a member (say a `page` kind), the key would not move and the gate would not ask for the doc to be re-read. The entry's own note says this.

## Wanted

Teach the walker to read a `z.enum` arm's `entries`, or the shape zod 4 exposes, so each enum member is part of the arm's key. Then regenerate or re-key the entries this changes, and pin it with a fixture union that has one enum arm and one literal arm.

Reader who acts: the `packages/spec` tooling owner (`domain:spec`).

Related: #27928 / PR #29401.

Dedupe: searched `check-variant-docs z.enum`. Nothing open matched. **New.**
